headline: Internal ALB correctly configured and properly isolated to VPC traffic. Safe to merge.
suppressed: Cost reviewer flagged the ~$16-18/month ALB cost as unannounced in the PR description. However, the cost is implicit in the explicit addition of a new load balancer resource, which is visible in the diff. The technical decision to add an internal ALB for this efficiency gain has presumably already been approved; cost governance for new resources should be handled through budgeting processes, not retroactively in code review.
